earlier.claim: 19 Evidence lines across 9 concepts say a ticket's plan and verdicts are in `.loop/archive/` before `5b2ed1b`, but 14 of those tickets were never archived. Their files are under `.loop/plans/`, `.loop/evals/`, `.loop/reflections/` and `.loop/verdicts/` at `48f52e2`, and R8 only ever had a plan (it was a stub, with no verdicts).

minio.md says R10, R11 and R12 'were all still stubs in the loop ledger when 5b2ed1b reset the loop', but R12 was marked dropped in the ledger in a7aa595 (dropped: true), which the paragraph itself says two sentences earlier.

new.claim: The new Evidence wording calls `48f52e2` "the last commit before the `5b2ed1b` loop reset", but the parent of `5b2ed1b` is `2259e07`, with three stamp-only commits between them. The files the lines point to are the same at both commits, so readers still find them.
